title: How is Pablo Escobar connected to Winnie the Pooh?
description:
A TV star, two presidents, a first lady and NBC's Willard Scott connect Pablo Escobar to Winnie the Pooh in six real photos.

Pablo Escobar → Virginia Vallejo → Belisario Betancur → Ronald Reagan → Nancy Reagan → Willard Scott → Winnie the Pooh

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Pablo Escobar → Virginia Vallejo: In 1983, Colombian TV star Vallejo interviewed Pablo Escobar, and became his lover.
   Photo by La Vanguardia, via El Tiempo, Fair use (commentary): https://www.eltiempo.com/cultura/gente/fotos-de-famosos-colombianos-junto-a-narcotraficantes-608064
2. Virginia Vallejo → Belisario Betancur: In 1984, Vallejo was photographed with the president of Colombia.
   Photo by Virginia Vallejo archive, Fair use (commentary): https://virginiavallejo.com/sociales/
3. Belisario Betancur → Ronald Reagan: In 1985, Betancur visited Ronald Reagan at the White House.
   Photo by Reagan Library, CC BY 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1985_Betancur-Reagan_Washington.jpg
4. Ronald Reagan → Nancy Reagan: In 1981, Reagan and First Lady Nancy Reagan shared a laugh with Frank Sinatra in the Oval Office.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Ronald_Reagan_and_Nancy_Reagan_with_Frank_Sinatra_(cropped).jpg
5. Nancy Reagan → Willard Scott: In 1986, NBC weatherman Willard Scott gave Nancy Reagan a bear hug at the White House.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nancy_Reagan_Attending_The_Great_American_Family_Awards_Presentation_with_Willard_Scott_in_The_State_Dining_Room_-_DPLA_-_201e390316bae8d32c9e78c13ae7aff0.jpg
6. Willard Scott → Winnie the Pooh: And at the 1983 White House Easter Egg Roll, Scott posed with Winnie the Pooh himself.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Group_Shot_of_Cartoon-Comic_Book_Characters_with_Willard_Scott_During_The_Easter_Egg_Roll_on_The_South_Lawn_-_DPLA_-_a4a78b89f6ad3de82e82823717f31fb2.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#pabloescobar #winniethepooh #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
